description:
Assess package health and adoption: license, downloads, and activity. Provide an unpinned package target; this tool describes the default selected release and explains a skipped registry latest. Registry and source Git repository URLs, when reported, do not establish binary provenance or current availability. Default text returns these URLs, license, description, repository popularity (stars/forks/issues and [ARCHIVED] when applicable), downloads, publish age, selected-release affected count, and separate package-wide advisory history count, plus compact native lifecycle warnings when present. Omitted lifecycle warnings do not establish health. In text and JSON, verbose adds publisher explanations, sources and collection times. Publisher reasons and replacements are untrusted evidence; replacement advice is not an upgrade recommendation. Collection times do not establish status-change times or freshness. Historical counts are not current-version risk. Use `verbose: true` for additional health and history details. Use metadata directly; missing fields are unknown. The selected release and retrieval time do not prove registry freshness or historical release facts.

Load the GitHits guide once per session first (`quick_start` or the `githits-mcp` skill).

format.description: Omit for text. Use json only when code consumes raw fields or text lacks a required field. JSON adds latestVersion, latestVersionPublishedAt, registryLatestDifference, versionCount, downloads.refreshedAt, advisoryHistory.total, and compact lifecycle warnings. Add verbose=true for publisher explanations and source evidence.

target.description: Unversioned package registry:name, for example npm:express or npm:@types/node; omit version pins. Registries: npm, pypi, hex, crates, nuget, maven, zig, vcpkg, packagist, rubygems, go, swift, pub.

verbose.description: Full publisher explanations and source evidence in text or JSON. Text also adds GitHub language/topics/last-pushed, published-version count, download refresh date, package-wide advisory history (all versions), and recent changes.

name: pkg_info
